This article is a stub. The Woodchester Company of Mississauga, Ontario, was the Canadian distributor that advertised the
[Kyrotech AutoCoach](../equipment/common/pace-clock/kyrotech-autocoach.md) pace clock in 1984.

See the [vendors overview](index.md) for the other companies this wiki covers.
